FAQ

Common questions

Do you make the actual videos? ▾
For TikTok, we create AI-generated slideshows and write scripts — you or your team record the talking-head content (if applicable). We can also source and edit UGC-style content for certain industries.
Which platforms do you focus on? ▾
TikTok first (highest organic reach potential for most industries), then LinkedIn or Instagram depending on your audience. We don’t spread thin — we focus on the 2 channels with the best ROI for your business.
How much content do you post? ▾
Typically 5–7 posts per week across platforms. Volume is less important than consistency and quality — we focus on content that earns views, not just posts that check a box.
What industries work best for TikTok? ▾
Service businesses, healthcare, restaurants, home services, and B2B companies with a story to tell. TikTok’s algorithm rewards authenticity and value — industries that can demonstrate expertise on camera perform best.
Do I need a big following to get results? ▾
No. TikTok’s algorithm surfaces content to relevant audiences regardless of follower count. We’ve seen brand-new accounts hit 50K views within the first month with the right content.
